Commentary.Commentary: West Indies Women have sealed a thrilling series victory, adding the T20I title to their earlier ODI series win, taking an unbeatable 2-0 lead with a game to spare. Their explosive batting display in the second T20I, posting 201 runs, left the visitors reeling. Qiana Joseph's blistering start and Deandra Dottin's solid support made the difference. Notably, the West Indies' bowlers remained composed and professional, easily defending their massive total.

Bangladesh Women have faced a tough tour, securing only one win in the ODI series and struggling to make an impact in the T20I series. Although they showed promise in the first T20I, they were comprehensively outplayed in the second game. Despite their challenges, this tour serves as a valuable learning experience for Bangladesh Women. Recognizing the need for improvement across all aspects of the game, they're determined to finish the series on a high note with a win in the final T20I.
Commentary will be available at the start of the match.
